_about: Structure and vocabulary of the SAT Articulo 69-B CFF listing, used to shape the synthetic efos_list table. DEV/EVAL ONLY - src/ must never import this.
source_organization: Servicio de Administracion Tributaria (SAT) / Diario Oficial de la Federacion (DOF)
legal_basis: Articulo 69-B del Codigo Fiscal de la Federacion
how_it_was_obtained: Web search over public reporting of the SAT 69-B publications, including the DOF global definitive listings of 2025-10-03, 2026-03-13 and 2026-07-03 (oficio 500-05-00-00-00-2026-16059). The SAT listing CSV itself was NOT downloaded and NO real taxpayer record appears anywhere in this estate.

status_vocabulary_observed.presunto: Taxpayer presumed to have issued CFDI covering non-existent operations. Still within the 15-business-day rebuttal window / pending definitive resolution.
status_vocabulary_observed.definitivo: Definitive listing. Per the fifth paragraph of art. 69-B the CFDI issued by the taxpayer produce no fiscal effect.
status_vocabulary_observed.desvirtuado: Taxpayer rebutted the presumption. NOT USED: the official estate_schema.sql constrains efos_list.status to definitivo | presunto.
status_vocabulary_observed.sentencia_favorable: Listing set aside by a court ruling. NOT USED, same reason.

structural_facts_used_for_realism: A taxpayer reaches 'definitivo' only after first appearing as 'presunto', so a definitive publication date is always later than the corresponding presumption.
Listings are published in the DOF in batches on a small number of dates per year, so publication_date values cluster rather than spreading uniformly.
The legal effect attaches from the definitive publication, which is why the estate deliberately contains invoices issued BOTH before and after a publication_date.
ethical_note: Every RFC and legal_name in efos_list is synthetic and procedurally generated. No RFC was copied from the SAT listing. No invented transaction is attached to any real taxpayer.

generic_rfcs.XAXX010101000: Well-known generic RFC for operations with the general public (national). Present in the estate as an ordinary petty-cash counterparty decoy - it is a placeholder, not a taxpayer.
generic_rfcs.XEXX010101000: Generic RFC for foreign residents. Not used.
